title: As he and others see me
html_source: Buck mulligan holds a mirror up to Stephen, literally as well as reporting what others think of him.

anchor.text: As he and others see me
anchor.prefix:
strong wellknit trunk. 

 — Look at yourself, he said, you dreadful bard! 

 Stephen bent forward and peered at the mirror held out to him, cleft by a crooked crack, hair on end.
anchor.suffix:
. Who chose this face for me? This dogsbody to rid of vermin. It asks me too.
